alt: 年輕人抱著獎杯和畫作，開心接受朋友的祝賀。
scene_prompt: A young adult in casual neat clothes walks joyfully out of a community exhibition carrying a small plain award cup and their successful framed landscape painting. Friends warmly congratulate them with smiles and applause, spring branches and soft breeze nearby. Face shows radiant satisfaction after a wished-for achievement, no writing on award or painting.
